title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.40: Fate Knocking's finisher preview no longer promises more damage than it can deal - it was counting Vigor twice, even though the three strikes consume it before the finisher lands. Practice now deals 1 base damage like the other pre-Tuned attacks.
